answer.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6% QoQ, both directly addressed by prior consolidated evidence (memory_31, memory_86) showing signup/onboarding simplification durably lifts SMB activation and time-to-value. This is a safer lever than promotional_pricing (memory_73), which explicitly warns deep discounts risk renewal and conflicts with the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue, especially given competitor price pressure already targeting price-sensitive accounts we don't want to race to the bottom with. Referral and enterprise-sales paths don't address the acute onboarding/activation drop this week. I want to verify the two onboarding-related memories' original records before committing the single experiment slot, since they're the basis for this decision and I have budget to check them; I'm not verifying memory_73 or memory_91 since I'm not selecting those paths this cycle. Scaling as a standard experiment (not broad rollout) preserves ability to measure impact on activation/completion without over-committing given only one slot this week and no fresh causal test since day 52/12.
